explanation: Pointing directly at a person with a single index finger is widely described as impolite across Arab countries, including the UAE, because it can come across as accusatory. The more common and accepted alternative is to gesture with the whole open hand toward the person or direction.
local_tip: Indicate a person or direction with your whole hand rather than a single pointed finger.

also_check.note: Pointing with a single finger is considered impolite; gesturing with the whole hand is preferred.
Index-finger pointing is considered offensive; many Indonesians instead point with the thumb.
Pointing with the index finger is common and mostly unremarkable in casual settings.

sources.title: Common Gestures People Use in Arab Countries
